meta.note: Scope of this file: ONLY the projects Eibad personally worked on, i.e. the 5 projects that have photographs in /public. The YMCO company profile lists 50+ projects; all others are deliberately excluded.
factsSourcedFrom: public/YMCO Company Profile (1).pdf — Youssef Marroun Contracting Co. company profile (87pp), portfolio section pp. 36-85
public/RX Training Center (Interior Visuals) 20241217.pdf — 'RX - Riyadh Air Flight Academy, 3D Visuals - Interior', Stylus ASD, 2024 (15pp)
public/RX Training Centre Architectural Elevations Updates_Sent to YMCO.pdf — 'Final Revised Elevations, aligned with KSIA guidelines' (5pp)

imageConventions.heicConversionRequired: public/Riyadh Air Academy/*.HEIC must be converted to JPEG — browsers cannot render HEIC
duplicatesFound: public/Nupco/WhatsApp Image 2026-09-27 at 9.08.36 AM.jpeg and ...at 9.08.37 AM.jpeg are byte-identical (md5 5bc0daa161); only the 9.08.36 copy is kept
imageConventions.heroImage: image = the card thumbnail (landscape, cropped to aspect-ratio 1.55/1.42/1.28). heroImage = the case study hero, which is full-bleed and TALL (~0.7 ratio), so it must be a different, preferably portrait, frame. CTH, CDC and French Fries have no portrait source, so their heroImage is a landscape photo centre-cropped into the tall frame.

toConfirm: CDC: YMCO profile says status 'On completed' (typo in source, read as 'Completed') and gives no year. Year 2025 — 2026 is inferred from the Red Sea cluster.
NUPCO Al Jouf: YMCO profile gives no year. 2024 — 2025 is inferred.
French Fries Processing Facility: YMCO profile gives no year. 2025 — PRESENT is inferred.

Riyadh Air interiors: Stylus ASD produced the interior visuals (Reception, Cafeteria, Classroom, Majlis, Office, Instructor's Room, Briefing Room, Corridor) and YMCO built it. Confirm how Eibad's contribution should be worded given the design authorship split.

futureRenders.note: Append entries to a project's images[] to add visualization work. Nothing else needs to change - the case study gallery, sitemap and /work/[slug] pages all read from images[].

kindMeaning.photo: site photography taken during the works
kindMeaning.render: 3D visualization - set the matching tool in the caption
kindMeaning.drawing: technical drawing, shop drawing or sketch issued as part of the works

futureRenders.creditRule: Set credit when a visual is NOT Eibad's own work. The Stylus ASD / Savills interior visuals and the KSIA elevation sheets for the Riyadh Air Training Centre are the designer's, so they must be credited rather than presented as his visualization.
futureRenders.placeholderNote: Projects with no image yet can set image/heroImage to null; the card should then fall back to a coloured block using the project number rather than rendering a broken image.

drawingsConvention.note: Every project has a drawings[] array rendered as a bottom carousel with a click-to-open popup modal. It currently holds the 3 shared placeholders in /public/drawings/.
replacingWithRealPlans: Export each issued plan as JPEG or PNG at up to 3840px on the long edge (4K), quality 85+. Do not serve raw multi-MB TIFFs; next/image cannot optimise those.
Save them per project, e.g. /public/projects/nupco-al-jouf/drawings/01-ground-floor-plan.jpg, and update that project's drawings[] src/alt/label/title/caption.
Set placeholder: false on every real drawing. Any entry with placeholder: true renders a PLACEHOLDER badge in the carousel and modal.
Keep width/height accurate - the modal uses them for the intrinsic aspect ratio.
Kind is drawing for issued plans/sections/details, model for 3D model captures, photo for site markup photos.

projects.title: Riyadh Air Academy
projects.subtitle: Aircraft cabin crew training centre and simulators building, GACA Complex
projects.site: Airport Road, GACA Complex — King Salman International Airport District Master Plan
projects.summary: A 21 m high cabin crew training and simulators facility rising inside the GACA Complex, pairing a steel simulator hall with a three-level concrete building of classrooms, offices and administration space.
projects.description: A 21 metre high aircraft cabin crew training centre facility and simulators building located in the Airport Road GACA Complex. Made of a steel structure simulator building and a 3-level concrete building for the admin, offices, classrooms and facility areas.
materials: Riyadh stone and dark metal — classroom buildings
highlights: 21 m high cabin crew training centre and simulators building, 11,560 m²
Steel structure simulator hall plus a 3-level concrete classroom and office building
Interior programme of reception, cafeteria, classrooms, majlis, offices, instructor's room, briefing room and corridor
Final revised elevations aligned with KSIA guidelines — Riyadh stone, coregated coated metal and bronze accents

projects.title: Red Sea Central Transportation Hub & QC Lab
projects.subtitle: Maintenance, repair and driver welfare facility for a regional transport fleet
projects.client: The Red Sea Real Estate Co.
projects.location: Red Sea, West Region, Saudi Arabia
projects.summary: A 12 m high steel structure transport hub organised around maintenance bays, repair workshops and full driver welfare provision, delivered as a coordinated piece of regional infrastructure.
projects.description: A 12 m high steel structure building consisting of a maintenance area and repair shops for light goods vehicles and heavy goods vehicle buses, separated based on functional and operational requirements. The building also houses driver support and welfare areas, including washrooms, changing rooms, a shared canteen, lockers and a prayer room for all staff and drivers.
highlights: 12 m high steel structure maintenance and repair building
Light goods and heavy goods bus repair workshops, zoned by function
Full driver welfare suite — washrooms, changing rooms, shared canteen, lockers, prayer room
Architectural shop drawings and technical documentation for the completed works

projects.title: NUPCO — Al Jouf Distribution Centre
projects.subtitle: 20 m high temperature-controlled medical supplies warehouse
projects.summary: A 20 m high pharmaceutical logistics centre built around temperature-controlled storage at a range of set points, with annexure buildings and provision for future expansion of NUPCO's supply needs.
projects.description: A 20 m high warehouse for the storage and distribution of medical supplies and equipment, including annexure buildings and infrastructure works on site. The warehouse includes temperature-controlled storage areas with a variety of temperature ranges, along with provision for future expansion to accommodate NUPCO's future needs.
highlights: 20 m high pharmaceutical warehouse, 35,000 m²
Temperature-controlled storage across a variety of temperature ranges
Annexure buildings and full on-site infrastructure works
Designed for future expansion as NUPCO's requirements grow

projects.title: Red Sea Central Distribution Center
projects.subtitle: CDC — a 50,600 m² one-stop-shop logistics warehouse for the Red Sea corridor
projects.client: The Red Sea Real Estate Co.
projects.location: Red Sea, West Region, Saudi Arabia
projects.summary: A 14 m high steel structure logistics warehouse built as a single point of supply for the Red Sea corridor, combining bulk storage with a mezzanine office and a fitted racking system.
projects.description: A 14 m high steel structure logistics warehouse building for a 'one-stop-shop' service, covering bulk storage and delivery needs for a wide range of generic and brand-specific products including food, OS&E and consumables.
highlights: 14 m high steel structure logistics warehouse, 50,600 m²
One-stop-shop model — bulk storage and distribution in a single facility
Food, OS&E and consumables storage across a multi-tenant inventory
Inserted mezzanine office and fitted high-bay pallet racking
